Def.Content: with an imperative: make sure that, better do.

Examples.Phrase: Ikaw bayà ang nanghilabut, ayaw pamasángil,
Examples.Gloss: You touched it. Don’t try to make excuses.

Def.Content: particle with a statement or exclamation: [so-and-so] is different than it should be.

Examples.Gloss: You’re joking, though you shouldn’t be.
Hmm, you’re acting like a child.
How good of you, but you shouldn’t have.

Examples.Phrase: Bayang kusúga níyang midágan, mu rag unsáun siya,
Examples.Gloss: God! How he ran away. As if I were going to do s.t. to him. ‘Panginum mu áning kúk, u.’—‘Busug pa bayà ku, bay,’ ‘Here, drink this coke.’—‘No thanks, I’m still full.’

Def.Content: why should that be the case when ...

Examples.Phrase: Wà nay bugas? Nagpalit bayà aku gahápun,
Examples.Gloss: There’s no rice? Why? I just bought some yesterday.

Def.Content: particle conceding that s.t. is the case which one didn’t think to be so.Nákug dì ka kamaung mulútù. Lamì bayà, I thought you didn’t know how to cook. But I must say it’s good.

Examples.Gloss: I did not know Manila was this big.

Def.Content: particle with a condition: a feared consequence will happen if the condition happens (had happened, were to happen).

Examples.Phrase: Bayáay (bayà) na man ug nasakpan pa ta. Prísu giyud,
Examples.Gloss: God! If we had been caught. It would have meant jail.
